description: Source file providing functions to retrieve and cache system environment attributes such as MAC addresses, CPE ID, serial number, manufacturer, model, and hardware version. It reads configuration files and interacts with hardware abstraction layer (HAL) functions.

methods.name: getSystemVersion
methods.description: Populates a systemVersion structure with data read from a version file.

methods.name: getSystemCpeId
methods.description: Returns the CPE ID derived from the MAC address by removing colons.

methods.name: getSystemCpeIdLowerCase
methods.description: Returns the CPE ID in lowercase.

methods.name: getSystemCpeIdUpperCase
methods.description: Returns the CPE ID in uppercase.

methods.name: getSystemSerialLabel
methods.description: Returns the system's serial number label.

methods.name: getEtcConfigDir
methods.description: Loads the configuration directory path if not already loaded.
